items.html: And it follows that these Mochin spread throughout all the nine Sefirot of ZA, and they have two garments: one is the garments of the NHY of Tevunah, and the second are the garments of the body of ZA, within which the NHY of Tevunah are clothed. And it follows that they are a garment within a garment; and nevertheless, the essence of the Mochin are only those in the KHB of ZA, for the rest of the Mochin that spread through the lines are not actual Mochin. And this was explained in its place, with the help of God.
